integrity: Original exact fixed-stepsize positivity criterion from arXiv:2610.01063v1 is explicitly credited; new claim is a sharp mode-count/topology theorem and universal realizability. Computational checks support, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional exact-arithmetic first SAV-BE step at fixed initial state; not a claim about whole trajectories, other SAV variants, state positivity, or finite-precision behavior. Historical equivalents remain possible.
title: Sharp spectral-mode bound and arbitrarily reentrant auxiliary positivity in original SAV backward Euler
